residuals.detail: The program is selected textual interpretation, not complete core coverage. Finite implementation excludes complete result carriers, conjunction/effect dependency integration, retained-component-set union, applicability, independent negative support in nonperformed conjunction slots, missing or unauthenticated joins, non-Boolean dependency ordering, workspace reacquisition/invalidation/freshness, construction and configuration. Family fidelity is unresolved without its exact source frame. Encoding under the RC2 tool does not establish successor-calculus equivalence.
Family relationships are modeled, not every fine domain rule, predecessor disposition, publication asset or normative clause. Whole-corpus fidelity and acceptance remain open.

Finite examples are separately authored executable interpretations, not execution of a_c clauses or independent source-fidelity acceptance. Real external effects and whole-method adequacy remain outside them.
